statement: Every case below is a plan. No test, replay, store call, browser run or provider call was made by the worker. A planned case becoming a passing run is evidence only after a later authorized implementation and Local review.
oracleAuthorship: Declared by the worker from the contract and the pinned sources before any implementation exists. The independent Local probe must author separate assertions; this plan is input, not its oracle.
inputOrder: Each case lists inputs before expected assertions. Unknowns that a user would supply later are not demanded at an earlier stage.

proposedEnvelope.rollbackBoundary: Revert the candidate commit set limited to writePaths. No store, auth, ACL, lock or data change exists to undo; stored v2 records remain readable by reopen and are refused by reverted prepare (fail closed).

frozenLegacyControls.captureRule: Capture all digests from the base commit a27c13fa7 before any edit, by calling the unmodified producers, and commit them as constants in the golden test. They are null here because the worker may not run code.
frozenLegacyControls.captureStatus: TO_CAPTURE_AT_BASE_BY_IMPLEMENTER; Local probe captures its own independently

FX-B.name: Workshop tool-lending log (a different job, built to falsify generalization)
FX-B.synthetic: Invented tools and roles; first names only as placeholders; no real data.

values.problem: Volunteers lend shared workshop tools and later forget who has which tool.
values.targetUsers: Volunteers (record loans and returns); workshop lead (view all loans)
values.coreFeatures:
1. Record a loan
2. Record a return
3. List overdue loans
values.successCriteria: The workshop lead can list every unreturned tool at any time.
values.mustPreserve: Existing tool tag codes stay unchanged.
values.dataNeeds: Tool tag, borrower first name, date lent.
values.outOfScope: No user accounts or logins. No fines or payments.
values.constraints: A loan lasts at most 14 days.

inputs.decisions: all six answered with short synthetic prose; no prose markers

items.text: How dates are displayed is not decided.
items.delegation: Any common date format is acceptable; do not convert time zones.

items.text: What happens when a tool is lent to someone who is not a volunteer is not decided.
The lead must view all loans, which implies identifying people, but outOfScope forbids user accounts and logins.

expected.noFourthUnknown: no case demands a fourth item or a minimum count
expected.crossQuestionConflict: C1 is held under access and cites outOfScope, which belongs to the boundaries mapping

invariants.statement: A state with no items serializes, renders, hashes and binds exactly as at the base commit.
No existing strict check is relaxed; v1 and v2 each have exact key sets; unknown shapes are rejected.
No output of this change asserts build readiness or an execution grant; the line says NOT_ASSESSED and the scope literal is unchanged.
Items come only from user entry; prose is never parsed; no completeness claim is made about the list.
No minimum or maximum expected count; the cap is a fail-closed safety bound that never truncates.
Inputs precede expectations in every case, and later-supplied unknowns are not demanded earlier.
Store, actor, auth, routes, API, client, exporter and readiness builder stay byte-identical.

independentProbeMapping.positiveControl: AC-B1 together with AC-L3: the contract preserves the named fourth known unknown and the legacy acceptance boundary

negativeMutationClasses.method: recompute raw sha256 of the nine CVF pins and the fourteen selected plus two dependency upstream files and compare with the ledger in the assessment file; a changed digest must fail the comparison
remove U4 from the FX-A S1 expectations or inputs in a scratch copy; the S1 expectation of four open ids and open count 4 must then disagree
apply the S2C change to a scratch state and assert the acknowledgement is cleared and the candidate is refused
add a readiness assertion or a buildReady key to a scratch candidate and assert rejection

independentProbeMapping.oracleSeparation: The Local assertions must be written independently of this plan and executed in a separate invocation; plan expectations are inputs to review only.

claimBoundary: A plan only. NOT_EXECUTED for every case. No implementation, runtime, provider, store, UI, UX, source fit, build-ready or live-governance claim. The envelope is proposed, not authorized.
